nodes.name: PRD.md
nodes.summary: Product Requirements Document for Component Stories — Admin Panel User Management System. Defines RBAC system (User→Role→Permission→Guard), CRUD features for users/roles/permissions/guards, DataTable browse capabilities (search, sort, pagination, column visibility), JWT authorization flow, API endpoints, client routes, seed data, and non-functional requirements (security, performance, UX).

nodes.name: architecture.md
nodes.summary: System architecture for Nuxt 4 monolith — frontend (Vue 3 + Naive UI + Tailwind) and backend (Nitro server routes with TypeORM + SQLite). Covers project structure, file-based routing, API endpoint specifications with query parameters and DTOs, RBAC system (JWT validation, guard/permission enforcement via server middleware and client composables), entity relationships (User→Role→Permission→Guard with junction tables), DataTable component specification, and client-side authorization patterns.

nodes.name: database.md
nodes.summary: Database schema for SQLite via TypeORM. Defines 12 entities: users, roles, permissions, guards, users_roles, roles_guards, roles_permissions, guard_urls, permission_methods, permission_urls, activity_logs, settings. Includes junction tables for many-to-many relationships, foreign key constraints with CASCADE deletes, indexes, and seed data for initial setup.

nodes.name: design-system.md
nodes.summary: Design system using Naive UI + Tailwind CSS v4. Defines color palette (primary blue #3B82F6, grays, semantic colors), typography scale, spacing/border-radius tokens, component dimensions, detail-view pattern (.detail-view CSS replacing NDescriptions), DataTable features (global search min 320px, column visibility, sorting, pagination), log level badges, layout dimensions (sidebar 220px, navbar 52px), sidebar navigation with <a> tag pattern, responsive breakpoints, icon library (@vicons/carbon), animation tokens and Vue transitions, and authorization UI patterns (access denied alert, conditional rendering).
